section13_checks.prohibition_description: Treating Grant Agreement Annex templates as the governing structural schema for proposal writing.
Inventing call constraints, scope requirements, expected outcomes/impacts not present in Tier 2B.
Inventing project facts (partners, capabilities, roles, objectives, budget) not present in Tier 3.
Commencing any Phase 8 activity before the budget gate (Phase 7) has passed.
Storing durable decisions only in agent memory without writing them to Tier 4.
Allowing a workflow or skill to become a de facto constitutional authority.
Silently reordering phases or weakening gate conditions.
Finalizing proposal text when source state is incomplete/contradictory/unvalidated without flagging.
Using agent-local knowledge of Horizon Europe rules as a substitute for Tier 1 source documents.
Producing Tier 5 outputs not traceable to specific inputs in Tier 1-4.
Modifying Tier 1 or Tier 2 source documents to reflect project-specific assumptions.
Treating CLAUDE.md as advisory or optional.

check_notes.13.1: Structural authority is the Tier 2A application-form schema (traceability_footer references docs/tier2a_instrument_schemas/extracted/section_schema_registry.json, instruments[MSCA-PF].sections). References to 'grant-agreement implementation provisions' and 'grant_agreement_implementation_articles' are cited as Tier 1 governance source_basis for escalation routing, not as a proposal structural schema. No 'Annex N', 'Grant Agreement Annex', 'AGA Template', or 'Model Grant Agreement template' is used as a structural authority.
check_notes.13.2: Call-requirement claims (SR-07, CC-09, CC-07) carry Tier 2B source references in traceability_footer (docs/tier2b_topic_and_call_sources/extracted/scope_requirements.json and call_constraints.json). The gender-dimension claim self-flags the absence of a Tier 2B exemption source and defers to Phase 8 ('either add the relevant Tier 2B topic-source reference or keep the claim framed as pending call-specific confirmation'), rather than inventing a call constraint.
check_notes.13.3: Project-fact claims (HOST/SUPERVISOR/CO_SUPERVISOR/FELLOW/SOFTWARE_PARTNER/VALIDATION_PARTNER/VALIDATION_SITE, HUN-REN ATK, MATE archive, AgroVIR placement, field-access status) carry Tier 3 references in traceability_footer (consortium/partners.json, consortium/roles.json, call_binding/*). Per skill scope, only the presence of a Tier 3 reference is checked, not the fact's presence in the Tier 3 files.
